name: Stromkirk Noble
oracle_text:
This creature can't be blocked by Humans.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: This creature can't be blocked by Humans.

needs.what: a static continuous effect that restricts which creatures may block the source, filtered by a characteristic of the would-be blocker (here `subtypes: ["Human"]`) -- i.e. an evasion effect of the form "this creature can't be blocked by <filter>", evaluated when blockers are declared rather than as a granted keyword
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `static_effects` offers only `buff`, `grant_keyword`, `set_pt`, `add_subtype` and `extra_land_drops` -- all of which change characteristics of permanents, none of which constrains the legality of a block. The nearest keyword is `menace` (and `flying`/`reach`), but those are fixed evasion rules with no filter: menace requires two or more blockers of any type and would let a single Human block alongside a second creature, while this card must forbid Humans outright and permit any one non-Human blocker. `static_filter_keys` does contain `blocking` and `subtypes`, but a filter alone has no restriction effect to attach to -- there is no effect kind that consumes it to veto a block declaration.

closest_existing: static_effect grant_keyword with a subtypes filter
